children: Michelle R Keating, an officer serving as Vice President, reported a sale of common stock on 2026-09-04. The shares were sold at a weighted average price of $30.536 per share, with individual sale prices ranging from $30.485 to $30.64. The total sale amount was $610,720 for 20,000 shares disposed of. Following the reported transaction, Keating directly owns 25,272 shares of common stock, which includes 78.85 shares held in the Kennametal 401(k) Plan.
